kills.property: A Deposit call never reverts when no Ether is sent, whereas M always reverts regardless of parameters.
kills.change_summary: Replace the require check with a false condition so Deposit always reverts, preventing any balance change.

kills.property: Depositing Ether must not change the balance of the zero address.
kills.change_summary: Change the credited account from msg.sender to a constant zero address so the caller's balance is unaffected.

kills.property: After Initialized has been called, calling SetMinSum always reverts regardless of the input value.
kills.change_summary: Delete the require statement that prevents re-initialization, allowing MinSum to be changed after initialization.

kills.property: MinSum can only be set before initialization
kills.change_summary: Replace the condition in the require statement with 'false', permanently preventing MinSum from being set.

kills.property: SetMinSum reverts if and only if the contract is already initialized.
kills.change_summary: Remove the negation on the initialized check so that MinSum can only be set if already initialized.

kills.property: After Setup, calling SetMinSum with any positive value must update MinSum to at least that value if uninitialized
kills.change_summary: Replace the state variable assignment with a no-op assignment to a non-existent variable, leaving MinSum unchanged.
